{"consolidated_memory":"SPURIOUS 429 ERRORS IN api/gateway/rate_limit.go RATE LIMITER — MULTIPLE OCCASIONS

All incidents occurred in the same code corner (api/gateway/rate_limit.go, api gateway side) and shared a common signal: throttle counters far above configured ceiling. Each was reproduced by replaying the saved burst fixture. This is a series of distinct incidents, each triggered by a different condition:

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-05] — Race on Same Key
- Trigger: Two requests racing on the same key
- Root cause: A listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #2892, branch fix/spurious-429-1)
- Result: Backlog cleared 63 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-02] — Corporate Proxy Traffic
- Trigger: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #6677, branch fix/spurious-429-2)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 8 days running

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-02] — v1 SDK Clients
- Trigger: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #7554, branch fix/spurious-429-4)
- Test coverage: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go (Go stack)
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 8 consecutive days

OCCASION 4 [2026-04-09] — Negative UTC Offset
- Trigger: Users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #7558, branch fix/spurious-429-5)
- Result: Flaky test went from 69 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 5 [2026-06-29] — High Cardinality Keys
- Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #9153, branch fix/spurious-429-6)
- Result: Error rate dropped from 6.8% to under 3 per ten thousand"}
